messages.content:
You are the compliance judge for messages an AI agent drafts to small merchants. The draft has already passed the rule checks in code. Read it for softer problems (Compliance rules §7.2):

- Implied promises of credit, eligibility, approval or outcomes (Compliance rules §2). "You can apply; the lender will assess your eligibility" is allowed.
- Pressure or false urgency (§3.1).
- Any link between credit and the UPI fee or the ₹1 lakh threshold (§3.2). Allowed and true: "Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application." That line alone, with no promise of an outcome, is not a link.
- Comparisons or claims the given facts do not support (§3.3).
- Fee statements that overstate or understate the fee, or do not say "proposed framework" (§6).
- The local-language text saying something different from the English version.

Return JSON: {"verdict": "pass" | "block" | "unsure", "rule": "Compliance rules §N" or null, "reason": "<one line>"}
Block only for a real problem you can point to. Use "unsure" when you cannot tell.

{
 "draft_kind": "loan_offer",
 "english": "Ayush avare, Namaskara. Kaveri Finance Ltd has made an in-principle offer of a ₹90,000 loan. It is available for a tenure of 12 months at 24% APR. The processing fee is 2% of the loan amount plus GST. There is no prepayment charge after 6 EMIs; a 2% charge on the principal prepaid before that. A late payment charge of 2% a month on the overdue EMI applies. For more details, see the Key Fact Statement: https://kfs.example.com/Q-M0077-20261031. This offer is valid until Sun 15 Nov. You can apply if you wish, and the lender makes the final decision. Thank you, Merchant support team.",
 "message": "ಆಯುಷ್ ಅವರೆ, ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. ಕಾವೇರಿ ಫೈನಾನ್ಸ್ ಲಿಮಿಟೆಡ್ ₹90,000 ಸಾಲದ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಆಫರ್ ನೀಡಿದೆ. ಇದು 12 ತಿಂಗಳ ಅವಧಿಗೆ 24% APR ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿದೆ. ಪ್ರೊಸೆಸಿಂಗ್ ಶುಲ್ಕವು ಸಾಲದ ಮೊತ್ತದ 2% ಜೊತೆಗೆ GST ಆಗಿದೆ. 6 EMI ಗಳ ನಂತರ ಮುಂಗಡ ಪಾವತಿಗೆ ಶುಲ್ಕವಿಲ್ಲ; ಅದಕ್ಕೂ ಮುಂಚೆ ಮುಂಗಡ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ಮೊತ್ತದ 2% ಶುಲ್ಕವಿದೆ. ತಡ ಪಾವತಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ 2% ದಂಡವಿದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ Key Fact Statement: https://kfs.example.com/Q-M0077-20261031. ಈ ಆಫರ್ Sun 15 Nov ವರೆಗೆ ಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ನೀವು ಇಚ್ಛಿಸಿದರೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಬಹುದು, ಅಂತಿಮ ನಿರ್ಧಾರವನ್ನು ಸಾಲದಾತರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, Merchant support team.",
 "facts": {
  "merchant": "Vora Hotel",
  "owner_first_name": "Ayush",
  "language": "Kannada",
  "lender": "Kaveri Finance Ltd",
  "amount": "₹90,000",
  "tenure": "12 months",
  "apr": "24% APR",
  "processing_fee": "2% of the loan amount plus GST",
  "prepayment": "No prepayment charge after 6 EMIs; 2% of principal prepaid before that",
  "late_payment": "2% a month on the overdue EMI",
  "kfs_link": "https://kfs.example.com/Q-M0077-20261031",
  "valid_until": "Sun 15 Nov",
  "lender_basis": "average recorded UPI of the last 3 completed months: ₹92,472"
 }
}
